title: Source Arts Emerge
summary: Zhang Wuye shows off his ancestral stone compass and explains that his forebears held the title Heavenly Source Master and that a Great Emperor of old gathered the divine source of nine dragon veins into Purple Mountain. At the stone gate that hides the scroll, stone-clad dead cultivators attack, Ye Fan saves Lei Bo and Wang Shu, and Zhang Wuye is knocked out and carried home, where the villagers mourn him and briefly blame Ye Fan until he wakes. Lei Bo and Wang Shu tell Ye Fan that a Zhang ancestor once beat a Jade Lake (Yaochi) Holy Maiden in a wager and that the North has had only five Heavenly Source Masters, then show him a topographic map of Purple Mountain carved by that ancestor, Zhang Lin. After a day of study Ye Fan reads it as 'Nine Dragons Guarding One Pearl' and finds the true entrance hidden in the Yin shadow of the dragon veins. Zhang Wuye then admits that Heavenly Source Masters' hair turns red in old age and they come to bad ends, and that Zhang Lin entered Purple Mountain to escape that curse and vanished along with the Heavenly Book of Source. Lei Bo and Wang Shu insist on going too, and Zhang Wuye gives them all stone clothing and stone knives made from the skin of divine source.
